Natural grading mu* = min (5 - #derivatives)/(degree - 1) over the support; on Q(5,1) (q_max = 1) mu* is one of 1, 5/4, 4/3, 3/2, 5/3 and is constant on every stratum. (i) mu* = 1 (some top-weight coefficient nonzero): principal simple poles a/s with A(a) = -c_60000 a^5 + c_41000 a^4 - (c_22000 + 2c_30100) a^3 + (c_03000 + 2c_11100 + 6c_20010) a^2 - (4c_00200 + 6c_01010 + 24c_10001) a - 120; the number of balances is the degree of A (5 with v^6, <= 4 without; generically simple); indices -1 and the roots of a quartic J_a with s1 = 16 + c_10001 a (ORD5 formulas, rechecked). On a stratum the top-weight support is a tail of the naming order (x0^6, x0^4x1, x0^3x2, x0^2x1^2, x0^2x3, x0x1x2, x0x4, x1^3, x1x3, x2^2), so the principal data depend only on m1. Four distinct positive integer indices at some principal balance are possible exactly for the tails from x0^6 ... x1x3 (283 strata; 261 if the always-present index-1 condition of the tails x1^3, x1x3 is also required); for the tail x2^2 alone (75 strata) the indices are -1, 1, 2, (13 +- i sqrt 71)/2. (ii) mu* in {5/4, 4/3, 5/3} (85 strata), and 8 strata with mu* = 3/2: no formal Laurent series with a pole of any integer order. (iii) mu* = 3/2 (34 strata): no principal pole; double poles (edge {x0^2x2, x0x1^2, x0^4}) and cancellation poles possible on 26 of them. (iv) Secondary poles (order m >= 2, x5 subdominant) need c_60000 = 0: 7 edge faces (m <= 4) and cancellations at the lattice points (4,2), (3,3), (3,2), (2,4), (2,3), (2,2) with c_P(m) = 0 for any m >= 2 (list in project note; the edges agree with NEWTON s01_newton.txt). A secondary formal family has at most 4 parameters wherever I_F is not identically zero; I_F == 0 occurs only on the face {x2^2, x0^2x2, x0^4} at m = 2, i.e. on a sublocus of the 4 strata 002|22|*. (v) Non-integer power behaviours (branching, not poles): a s^{-mu*} for mu* in {5/4, 4/3, 3/2, 5/3}; secondary a s^{-4/3} (face {x2^2, x1x3, x0x4, x0^5}) and a s^{-3/2} (faces {x1^3, x0x1x2, x0^2x3, x0^5} and {x2^2, x1x3, x0x4, x0^3x1}); s^{-m} with m a non-integer root of some c_P(m) on hypersurfaces. Logarithmic behaviour a s^{-1} (log 1/s)^{1/(D-1)} on the locus A == -120 (leading order only). (vi) Laurent families at the principal balances: very general members of the tails with v in the core have exactly one series per balance (REFQ51 E3); for the cores without v the index 1 (and 2 for v''^2) is always present and the compatibility conditions at these indices fail for the generic member of 138 strata (those with a weight-5 monomial, or Q_2 != 0 for v''^2; index 1: 117, index 2 only: 21) and for every member of 40 strata (index 1: 33, index 2: 7) (REFQ51 E1: on 21 of the 138 strata, v''^2 tail without a weight-5 monomial, the index-1 condition holds identically and the failure is at index 2, e.g. 0000|22|3). A very general member of 172 strata (a Zariski-generic member of 156 of them; not of the 8 strata 002|002|*, where every member on infinitely many hypersurfaces has a formal Laurent series with a pole of order m, PROVED-HERE by REFQ51; on the 8 strata {01,00,0,x0-free}|13|{4,12} Zariski genericity is undecided), and every member of 113 strata, has no formal Laurent series with a pole (REFQ51 E2).
